headlines.title: 央行潘功胜：维护股票、债券、外汇等金融市场平稳运行
headlines.summary: 金十数据11月3日讯，十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议3日上午在北京人民大会堂举行第二次全体会议。会议听取了中国人民银行行长潘功胜受国务院委托作的关于金融工作情况的报告。报告介绍了2025年10月以来金融工作主要进展及成效、当前经济金融形势和问题挑战，提出下一步工作考虑：继续实施好适度宽松的货币政策，为经济持续向新向优向好发展营造适宜的货币金融环境；进一步加强和完善金融监管，不断增强监管质效；实施好支持资本市场的货币政策工具，巩固完善资本市场稳市机制。维护股票、债券、外汇等金融市场平稳运行，守住不发生系统性金融风险底线。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng: Maintaining stable operation of financial markets including stocks, bonds and foreign exchange
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, November 3: The 25th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th National People's Congress held its second plenary meeting on the morning of the 3rd at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. The meeting heard a report on financial work delivered by PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng on behalf of the State Council. The report covered the main progress and results of financial work since October 2025, the current economic and financial situation and challenges, and set out next steps: continue to implement a moderately loose monetary policy to create a suitable monetary and financial environment for the economy's sustained development toward innovation, improvement and positive momentum; further strengthen and improve financial regulation, continuously enhancing regulatory quality and effectiveness; implement monetary policy tools supporting the capital market and consolidate and improve the capital market stabilization mechanism. Maintain the smooth operation of stock, bond, foreign exchange and other financial markets, and hold the bottom line of preventing systemic financial risks. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 中国民生银行温彬：上调外汇存款准备金率是公开透明的市场化措施
headlines.summary: 近期人民币持续走强，11月3日中国人民银行果断出手上调金融机构外汇存款准备金率，稳定市场预期，维护外汇市场平稳运行。上调外汇存款准备金率，收紧境内美元流动性，缓解人民币升值压力；在人民币汇率过快贬值时，可下调外汇存款准备金率，缓解人民币贬值压力。历史上，中国人民银行曾多次调整外汇存款准备金率。2021年央行两次上调外汇存款准备金率至9%；2022年至2023年，央行三次下调外汇存款准备金率至现行的4%。

headlines.title_en: Wen Bin of China Minsheng Bank: Raising the FX deposit reserve ratio is an open and transparent market-based measure
headlines.summary_en: The renminbi has strengthened continuously recently. On November 3, the PBOC acted decisively to raise the foreign exchange deposit reserve ratio of financial institutions, stabilizing market expectations and maintaining the smooth operation of the foreign exchange market. Raising the FX deposit reserve ratio tightens domestic US dollar liquidity and eases upward pressure on the renminbi; when the renminbi depreciates too quickly, the ratio can be lowered to ease depreciation pressure. Historically, the PBOC has adjusted the FX deposit reserve ratio multiple times. In 2021, the central bank raised it twice to 9%; from 2022 to 2023, it lowered the ratio three times to the current 4%.

headlines.title: 连平：央行本次上调外汇存款准备金率，其目的是避免单边快速升值预期、增强市场双向弹性、提高机构风险意识
headlines.summary: 中国首席经济学家论坛理事长、国际金融研究院院长连平表示，本次上调外汇存款准备金率，是央行在当前人民币偏强、外汇供给较充裕背景下，对汇率单边波动和外汇流动性所作的一次宏观审慎调节，其目的是避免单边快速升值预期、增强市场双向弹性、提高机构风险意识，意在前瞻性引导金融机构、出口企业和个人理性对待汇率风险，增强套期保值等外汇风险对冲工具运用的意识。

headlines.title_en: Lian Ping: The PBOC's raising of the FX deposit reserve ratio this time aims to avoid one-sided rapid appreciation expectations, enhance two-way market flexibility, and raise institutions' risk awareness
headlines.summary_en: Lian Ping, chairman of the China Chief Economist Forum and dean of the International Finance Institute, said the latest increase in the FX deposit reserve ratio is a macroprudential adjustment by the PBOC to one-sided exchange rate fluctuations and FX liquidity against the backdrop of a relatively strong renminbi and ample foreign exchange supply. Its purpose is to avoid expectations of rapid one-sided appreciation, enhance two-way market flexibility, raise institutions' risk awareness, and proactively guide financial institutions, exporters and individuals to treat exchange rate risk rationally and increase their awareness of using hedging and other FX risk tools.

headlines.title: 王毅同菲律宾外长拉扎罗通电话
headlines.summary: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅3日应约同菲律宾外交部长拉扎罗通电话。 王毅表示，当前中菲关系面临恶意干扰，菲少数政客出于政治偏见和一己私利，一再攻击抹黑中国，踩踏中方红线，将正常的经贸人文交流政治化，侵害中国在菲人员和机构的正当权益。这种恶行丧失理智，不可容忍，也损害菲的国际形象。菲方应加强对有关人员的约束，在对华政策上发出理性、统一的声音。中方维护主权和领土完整、实现国家统一的意志坚定不移。菲方应将一个中国政策落到实处，在涉海问题上谨言慎行。

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi speaks by phone with Philippine Foreign Secretary Lazaro
headlines.summary_en: On the 3rd, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, took a phone call from Philippine Foreign Secretary Lazaro. Wang Yi said China-Philippines relations currently face malicious disruption; a handful of Philippine politicians, out of political bias and personal gain, have repeatedly attacked and smeared China, crossed China's red lines, politicized normal economic, trade and cultural exchanges, and infringed on the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese personnel and institutions in the Philippines. Such behavior is senseless and intolerable and damages the Philippines' international image. The Philippine side should tighten constraints on relevant personnel and speak with a rational and unified voice on China policy. China's will to safeguard sovereignty and territorial integrity and achieve national reunification is unwavering. The Philippines should implement the one-China policy and act and speak prudently on maritime issues.

headlines.title_en: J.P. Morgan Asset Management: A-share market trends may improve, and investment value is beginning to emerge in some sectors
headlines.summary_en: At the 2026 Q4 Global Market Outlook and Active ETF Seminar held on November 3, Zhu Chaoping, senior global market strategist at J.P. Morgan Asset Management, noted that globally, manufacturing and services PMIs are generally in expansion territory, with services stronger than manufacturing and regional divergence continuing; US inflation is gradually falling, and the Fed's subsequent rate path remains a key variable for global asset pricing. In addition, investors are focused on the outlook for global AI capital expenditure, but commercialization penetration varies across industries, requiring scrutiny of whether corporate investment is truly materializing and whether profits are being delivered. On asset allocation, the 60/40 stock-bond model portfolio framework still has long-term reference value.

headlines.summary: 金十数据11月3日讯，十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议3日上午在北京人民大会堂举行第二次全体会议。会议听取了中国人民银行行长潘功胜受国务院委托作的关于金融工作情况的报告。报告介绍了2025年10月以来金融工作主要进展及成效、当前经济金融形势和问题挑战，提出下一步工作考虑：继续实施好适度宽松的货币政策，为经济持续向新向优向好发展营造适宜的货币金融环境；进一步加强和完善金融监管，不断增强监管质效；实施好支持资本市场的货币政策工具，巩固完善资本市场稳市机制。维护股票、债券、外汇等金融市场平稳运行，守住不发生系统性金融风险底线。（新华社）

headlines.summary: 【三季度中国央行购金创四年单季新高】11月3日，世界黄金协会发布的2026年三季度《全球黄金需求趋势》报告显示，中国人民银行三季度宣布了63吨的黄金增持，为2022年三季度以来的最高。央行已连续八个季度实现黄金净增持，截至9月末，中国官方黄金储备增至2410吨，占外汇储备总额的8.5%。2026年初至今，中国官方黄金储备累计增加103吨，是2026年全球购金最为活跃的央行之一。

headlines.title_en: PBOC gold purchases in Q3 hit a four-year quarterly high
headlines.summary_en: [PBOC Gold Purchases Hit Four-Year Quarterly High in Q3] On November 3, the World Gold Council's Q3 2026 Gold Demand Trends report showed that the People's Bank of China announced a 63-ton increase in gold holdings in Q3, the highest since Q3 2022. The PBOC has recorded net gold purchases for eight consecutive quarters, and as of the end of September, China's official gold reserves rose to 2,410 tons, accounting for 8.5% of total foreign exchange reserves. From the start of 2026 to date, China's official gold reserves have increased by a cumulative 103 tons, making the PBOC one of the world's most active central bank gold buyers in 2026.

headlines.title: “小作文”传野村下调中际旭创目标价至330元，野村回应：不属实
headlines.summary: 11月3日，一张标注发布机构为野村、声称将中际旭创A股目标价下调至330元的研报截图正在投资社群快速流转。在光模块板块情绪本就敏感的当下，这条消息迅速扩散，搅动个股盘面。 野村相关人士回复表示，“事宜不属实。”也就是说，野村从未发布过这份下调目标价的研报，相关流传内容属于不实信息。无论署名分析师、发布文号、盈利测算口径，均找不到对应的正式研报记录，不存在下调目标价至330元这一动作。（界面）

headlines.title_en: Rumor Has It Nomura Cut Zhongji Innolight's Target Price to 330 Yuan; Nomura Responds: Not True
headlines.summary_en: On November 3, a screenshot of a research report attributed to Nomura and claiming to cut the A-share target price of Zhongji Innolight to 330 yuan circulated rapidly in investor communities. With sentiment in the optical module sector already sensitive, the news spread quickly and roiled the stock's trading. A Nomura representative responded that 'the matter is untrue.' In other words, Nomura never published this target-price cut report, and the circulating content is false information. No corresponding formal research report record can be found, whether by named analyst, publication number or profit estimate basis, and no action to cut the target price to 330 yuan exists. (Jiemian)
